topic.angle: Sound is faster in water than in air

body.question: How fast does sound travel in fresh water at 20 °C?
body.reveal: About 1481 m/s, slightly more than 4.3 times as fast as in air, where it moves at 343 m/s. In iron it is 5120 m/s. Typically sound travels most slowly in gases, faster in liquids, and fastest in solids.

probes.question: How fast does sound travel in fresh water at 20 °C?
True or false: sound typically travels fastest in solids and slowest in gases.
